verdict.rationale: Fleet-wide configuration rollout is a fair question for a robotics software platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only documents per-node parameter set/retrieve, which is a developer building block, not a fleet-level mechanism for pushing config to many robots with group targeting. Missing for 10: any documented multi-robot config push, any per-group or fleet targeting, any rollout management.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can push configuration changes across many robots at once with per-group targeting
